## Why

The UI pass renders each changed view at 80x24 and 120x40, plus ASCII. When the changed behavior only shows on a shorter screen, those renders do not show the change. S580 is the example: a lift is a no-op at both sizes, because the roadmap-goals-home-80x24 render shows every line. The owner then sees renders that say nothing about the change.

Owner decision (adj 595, key `ui.render-short-fixture`): the rule goes in the Renders section of `internal/roles/prompts/ui.md`. When the changed behavior only shows below 80x24, the pass also renders at the height the tests use for that view and names that size in its report. The brief is not changed.
